title: Khaled / Founder & pilot
description: Dubai-based founder and pilot building AI products for customer operations and personal workflows. Explore prototypes, product progress and validation milestones.
about: My product work focuses on customer support, equipment quotations, leasing and personal workflows. I am developing Frame to turn spoken thoughts and conversations into useful memory and follow-through. Each product has a defined development stage and a specific next validation milestone.

projects.name: Quote Operations
projects.modelDescription: AI-assisted equipment quotation preparation for HVAC sales and estimating.
projects.audience: HVAC equipment sales and estimating teams
projects.buyer: Sales directors and quotation desk managers
projects.users: Salespeople, estimators and engineering or commercial reviewers
headline: Equipment quotes,
ready for review.
projects.summary: AI-assisted quotation preparation for HVAC sales teams. Match requests to equipment and pricing, with estimator and approver review.
features: With AI set up, paste an English or Arabic request from email or WhatsApp, or upload one printed PDF equipment list. The app reads the lines and quantities.
Review suggested products and available prices beside the request. Open a line to check where its product or price came from.
See missing quantities, uncertain selections and unavailable prices first. Keep technical decisions with your engineer.
Confirm the products, prices and terms, then get a colleague’s approval and download the quote. Customer changes get a new version; the earlier quote stays saved.
nextFocus: Compare one past request with the team’s approved quotation
Connect the products, selling prices and approval rules used for that job
Measure corrections and preparation time, separately from approval waiting time
projects.imageAlt: Quote Operations equipment review showing requested items beside suggested products, quantities and prices. Fictional sample data.
projects.demoNote: Watch real app clicks with local AI and fictional data, then try the prepared public sample without an account. Company catalogues, approved prices and team access still need setup. Email and WhatsApp are not connected automatically.

updates.text: A prepared equipment quote can be reviewed in the public sample. The next step is a customer pilot with an approved catalogue and real team access.
Simplified the request list and quotation review, made the website clearer for HVAC sales teams, and focused the demo on preparing the quote and checking the details.
Opened the public sample without an email, booking or account.

Compare a printed PDF equipment list with an approved product and selling-price catalogue
Revise a customer offer while preserving the earlier quotation and approval history

projects.name: Frame
projects.modelDescription: A personal voice workspace under development, with source-linked recall and user-reviewed follow-through.
projects.audience: Founders and independent professionals with recurring conversations and projects
projects.users: People capturing thoughts, reviewing commitments and recovering earlier context
projects.market: Personal use first; UAE audience under validation
projects.stage: Internal iPhone beta · Device acceptance pending
headline: Your words,
useful again.
projects.summary: A personal workspace for spoken thoughts, source-linked memory and next steps you choose.
features: Capture a thought or conversation deliberately, with local audio and editable notes.
Search saved notes, recover supporting passages and return to the original context.
Review tasks and prepare follow-up drafts; choose reminders and confirm calendar events yourself.
Keep selected notes out of AI and memory answers, with export and deletion controls.
Optional Apple on-device AI support is being tested on eligible devices. Light, olive-green dark and red night appearance are available.
nextFocus: Verify recording, recovery and source recall on a real iPhone
Test supported-language transcription and on-device AI honestly
Measure whether people return because the remembered context is useful
projects.demoNote: The gallery contains two updated references and the 16 original v8 concepts. These generated images are not running-app screenshots or proof every pictured feature is built. Physical-device acceptance remains pending.

updates.text: Build 3.0.0 (9) is verified in the internal Owner Testing group. It adds an optional chosen focus to the capture → review → recall → action workflow. Simulator checks support the implementation; physical-device acceptance and successful AI generation remain open.

projects.technicalReadiness: An internal iPhone beta with local capture, source-linked recall, reviewed tasks, drafts and manual Calendar handoff. Recording start, pause, resume, save and playback controls were exercised in the iOS 27 simulator. Physical-device acceptance and successful AI generation remain unverified. Optional AI requires an eligible device with iOS 26.4 or later and an enabled, ready Apple model.
projects.commercialReadiness: Private beta available for owner testing. Repeat use and willingness to pay remain unvalidated; no paid launch is available.
projects.positioning: Capture, source-linked recall and reviewed follow-through in one personal workspace.
projects.outcome: Recover the context behind your decisions and prepare your next step; usefulness remains under validation.
deliverables: A saved recording and editable note
Relevant source passages from saved notes
Reviewed tasks and editable follow-up drafts
useCases: Capture a thought before it is forgotten
Recall what was agreed in an earlier conversation
Prepare a follow-up from a saved note
projects.nextAction: Verify capture, source recall and a reviewed next step on a real iPhone, then observe repeat use with a small beta.

readinessChecks.label: Working app flows
readinessChecks.detail: Recording start, pause, resume, save and playback controls passed in the iOS 27 simulator. Manual notes, source navigation, tasks, drafts and Calendar handoff also have simulator evidence. These checks do not establish physical-device reliability.

readinessChecks.label: Voice and optional AI
readinessChecks.detail: On-device transcription depends on device and language support. Successful AI generation remains unverified: English generation failed in the simulator, with the cause not established; Arabic was unsupported in the tested configuration. Mixed Arabic–English quality remains unverified.

readinessChecks.label: Privacy and control
readinessChecks.detail: Private notes are excluded from AI and memory answers. Sharing, task acceptance, reminders and Calendar additions are deliberate user actions. Physical-device protection checks remain open.

readinessChecks.label: Internal distribution
readinessChecks.detail: Build 3.0.0 (9) completed Apple processing and is verified in Owner Testing (Internal, one tester), with test instructions saved. Installation and acceptance on the physical iPhone remain unverified.

readinessChecks.label: Customer usefulness
readinessChecks.detail: Repeat use and willingness to pay remain unvalidated. The next step is a small observed beta, before charging.
